package handler

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

// scenario for redis_get_set_without_pipeline: multiple sequential `rdb.Get(ctx, key)` or `rdb.Set(ctx, key, val, ...)` calls in the same function without pipeline
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func UpdateUserSessions(ctx context.Context, rdb *redis.Client, userID string) error {
	key := fmt.Sprintf("user:%s:last_login", userID)
	val, err := rdb.Get(ctx, key).Result()
	if err != nil && err != redis.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("redis get failed: %w", err)
	}
	_ = val

	cacheKey := fmt.Sprintf("user:%s:session", userID)
	if err := rdb.Set(ctx, cacheKey, time.Now().UTC().String(), 15*time.Minute).Err(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("redis set failed: %w", err)
	}

	countStr, err := rdb.Get(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("user:%s:logins", userID)).Result()
	if err != nil && err != redis.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("redis get failed: %w", err)
	}
	_ = countStr

	return rdb.Set(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("user:%s:active", userID), "true", 0).Err()
}
